Although the arithmetic validation passed (math_audit.is_arithmetic_valid = true, no discrepancies), duplicate detection flagged a potential duplicate (same supplier SUP-110 and identical total amount as historical invoice INV-HIST-0029). Given the high‑severity policy breach and the medium‑severity duplicate risk, the invoice cannot be approved outright and must be reviewed by a manager or the supplier for PO attachment and duplicate confirmation before any payment can be considered.
